mentions.name: PostgreSQL WASM (PGlite)
mentions.description: Browser-based PostgreSQL servers built on PGlite (PostgreSQL compiled to WebAssembly) with a cloud proxy over Websockets. All PostgreSQL data lives in the browser and persists locally, providing unlimited PostgreSQL servers without installing anything.
mentions.problem: The author often needs a PostgreSQL server for testing an application, vibe coding, or troubleshooting a PG client, which normally requires installing one locally.
mentions.audience: Developers who need a PostgreSQL server for testing applications, vibe coding, or troubleshooting PostgreSQL clients.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Inspired by Neon's architecture, I implemented PostgreSQL WASM (PGlite) with a cloud proxy (via Websockets) at https://postgresql.dbfor.dev

All the PostgreSQL data lives in your browser, and you have unlimited PostgreSQL servers that persist the data locally without installing anything.
